item.title: Gilead Yeztugo Launch
item.description:
• Summary: Gilead Sciences has set an ambitious first-year sales forecast of $1 billion for its new HIV drug Yeztugo, reflecting an unprecedented launch trajectory. The drug is expected to compete in the HIV market. Gilead's Q1 results also highlighted strong performance of Biktarvy.
  • MoAs: Yeztugo is a once-daily single-tablet regimen for HIV, likely containing an integrase strand transfer inhibitor (e.g., bictegravir) and NRTIs.
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology, Fierce Pharma, BioSpace

item.title: Hantavirus Outbreak
item.description:
• Summary: Recent reports detail a hantavirus outbreak linked to a cruise ship in Spain, leading to evacuations in the Canary Islands. STAT News covers the outbreak itself and the rapid spread of misinformation related to the virus. The articles highlight the public health response and the challenges of managing both the disease and false information.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News, STAT News

item.title: GSK Meningitis Campaign
item.description:
• Summary: GSK launched a new marketing campaign for its meningitis vaccines, using a 'modern family' theme to appeal to broader audiences, including parents and young adults. The campaign aims to raise awareness about meningococcal disease and the importance of vaccination.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma
